# lamejs 1.2.1

Unmodified copy of `lame.min.js` from the npm package [lamejs@1.2.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lamejs)
(source: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), used for the MP3 export of narration recordings.

License: LGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE` from the package and https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html).
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.net. Kept as a separate file, not modified.
